paras: Platyceps messanai, also known commonly as Messana's racer and Schätti's racer, is a species of snake in the subfamily Colubrinae of the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Somalia.
The specific name, messanai, is in honor of Italian biologist Giuseppe Messana.
Platyceps messanai is found in northern Somalia.
The preferred natural habitat of Platyceps messanai is shrubland, at elevations around 450 m (1,480 ft).
